BL.name: Built-in Larder
BL.evidence: 21,419 listings carry BOTH BA and BL simultaneously, ruling out BL=Balcony. BL is residential-only (buy/rent). Apify code list and web search confirm BL=Built-in Larder (kitchen pantry unit). PropertyFinder filter URL uses 'bl' for balcony in its UI but that conflicts with the dataset where BA is already balcony.

DN.name: Dining Room
